measurement_script:
import argparse,ctypes,hashlib,json,statistics,sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch,torch_npu
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'tests'))
from test_gdn_mega import _make_inputs,_prepare_gdn_mega,_expand_kv_heads,_reference
from gdn_mega_validation import error_metrics
from pto_kernels import pto_gdn_mega
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--mode',choices=['current','original'],required=True);a=p.parse_args()
torch.set_num_threads(4);torch.npu.set_device('npu:0');torch.npu.config.allow_internal_format=False
hal=ctypes.CDLL('libascend_hal.so');fn=hal.halGetDeviceInfo;fn.argtypes=[ctypes.c_uint,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.c_int,ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_longlong)]
f=ctypes.c_longlong();assert fn(0,0,25,ctypes.byref(f))==0
hz=f.value*1000
inputs=_make_inputs(4096,16,4);initial=torch.randn(1,16,128,128,dtype=torch.float16)*.1
q,k=_expand_kv_heads(inputs[0],inputs[1],16);expected,es=_reference(q,k,*inputs[2:],initial_state=initial)
args=_prepare_gdn_mega(*(x.to('npu:0') for x in inputs),torch.tensor([0,4096],dtype=torch.int32,device='npu:0'),initial.to('npu:0'))
records=[];times=[];checks=[]
for i in range(18):
 start,end=torch.npu.Event(enable_timing=True),torch.npu.Event(enable_timing=True)
 start.record();pto_gdn_mega(**args);end.record();end.synchronize()
 if i in [0,17]:
  checks.append({'output':error_metrics(args['out'].cpu(),expected.double()*128**.5,include_percentiles=False),'state':error_metrics(args['final_state'].cpu().view_as(es),es,include_percentiles=False)})
  if a.mode=='current': assert all(x['passed'] for x in checks[-1].values()),checks[-1]
 if i>=3:
  if a.mode=='current': x=args['g_sum'].view(torch.int64).flatten()[:24*3*16].reshape(24,3,16)
  else:x=args['kkt_workspace'].view(torch.int64).flatten()[:24*96].reshape(24,96)[:,:9]
  records.append(x.cpu().clone());times.append(start.elapsed_time(end))
t=torch.stack(records);med=t.double().median(0).values
if a.mode=='current':
 phase=(med[:16,:,1:3]*1e6/hz).tolist(); bins=(med[:16,:,3:11]*1e6/hz).tolist()
 assert (t[:,:16,:,14]==32).all() and (t[:,:16,:,15]==0).all(), 'Unexpected chunk/fallback counts'
else:
 phase=((t[:,:,1:9]-t[:,:,:8]).double().median(0).values*1e6/hz).tolist();bins=None
libs={line.split()[-1] for line in Path('/proc/self/maps').read_text().splitlines() if line.split()[-1].endswith('/libno_workspace_kernel.so')};assert len(libs)==1
result=dict(mode=a.mode,clock_hz=hz,shape=dict(tokens=4096,heads=16,key_heads=4,initial_state=True),samples=15,warmups=3,instrumented_event_median_ms=statistics.median(times),per_core_median_phase_us=phase,per_core_median_bins_us=bins,numerical_checks=checks,library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(libs.pop()).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),raw_ticks=t.tolist())
Path('benchmark_data/gdn_mega/profile_diagnostic_20261026/'+a.mode+'_timings.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['raw_ticks','numerical_checks']},indent=2))
